title.narrative: Strengthening the resilience of vulnerable populations in Jawzjan, Samangan, Balkh and Kabul

description.narrative: (1)Improved Access to drinking, livestock, irrigation water through improvement of water points, water systems and surface water catchment and infiltration.(2) Participation of women increased in social/economic spheres.(3)Livelihood/Food Security strengthened through agriculture production, value chain management & post harvest management with focus on livestock & range land management and conflict resolution.

Direct beneficiaries (planned) 13,061 households/44,051 individuals: (1) Male-18,865 individuals.(2) Female- 25,186 individuals.(3) Persons with disabilities- 5,575 individuals.Indirect beneficiaries (planned) 68,346 individuals:(1) male-26,238 individuals.(2) female- 42,108 individuals (3) persons with disabilities-8,889 individuals.

Project Objective: Vulnerable communities in Afghanistan improve their resilience to economic and climatic shocks by gaining access to diversified and adequate livelihoods, taking disaster risk reduction measures, conserving their natural resources and improving access to water services.Outcome 1:Vulnerable households are empowered to develop and diversify sources of income, secure their livelihoods and improve their food and nutrition security.Outcome 2:Local communities natural resource management skills and resilience to adapt and mitigate climate shocks are improved.Outcome 3:Vulnerable households in underserved communities increase their access to safe drinking water and demonstrate improved sanitation practices.

participating-org.narrative: Germany - Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development
